ops.title: hermes-on-Apple-container LIVE prototype (2026-07-15) verdict: NO-GO-for-now, lifecycle (#158/#286 no auto-restart) is the one confirmed blocker; found+fixed a CRITICAL proxy host-escape (socktainer docker.sock relay); egress isolable only via custom non-N

ops.body:
Ran the 5-experiment live prototype (task 89dbaae) with apple/container **1.1.0** + socktainer **1.1.1** installed on the host (user-approved). Verdict note **4656afb** (supersedes the old spike memo 452679f); full chronology + the proxy-fix diff attachment in cc-notes log **apple-container-prototype**.

**Verdict: NO-GO for immediate production. The ONE confirmed FAIL is lifecycle/recovery** — nothing auto-restarts (apiserver #158, socktainer + proxy unsupervised; apiserver died once on first-run, needs manual `container system start`). Fix = build a KeepAlive/boot-autostart supervision layer (the tart `write_agent` pattern). Everything else is favorable-to-neutral but each carries a named residual (NOT "all fixed except lifecycle").

**CRITICAL security finding (found by the codex refuter, fixed+verified)**: socktainer transparently relays a container-internal `/var/run/docker.sock` **target** to its raw unfiltered API regardless of source. `hermes-docker-proxy` screened bind/mount SOURCES but never DESTINATIONS → an agent behind the proxy mounted empty→`/var/run/docker.sock`, got the raw socktainer API, ran `--privileged -v /:/hostroot` and **read the host home (sops key + vault token)**. Full host compromise. Initially "fixed" with `forbiddenDest()` (reject any bind/mount whose `filepath.Clean`'d target basename is `docker.sock`) — but that ALONE was INCOMPLETE. On landing da1c63 (2026-07-16), three adversarial refuter passes found TWO more bypasses, both Go-vs-Swift parser differentials against socktainer's `split(separator:":", omittingEmptySubsequences:true)`: (1) ASCII empty-segment (`src::/docker.sock` → proxy dst="" allowed) → fixed by `splitBindSpec` (split, drop empty); (2) Unicode grapheme-cluster (combining mark after ':' merges in Swift, not Go) → fixed by rejecting non-ASCII bind/mount paths wholesale (`isASCII`). Landed fix = forbiddenDest + splitBindSpec + isASCII, verified SOUND vs real socktainer source + 20k-case fuzz. Full detail in cc-notes note 02d73219. NOT exploitable on live dockerd (no relay) but a hard socktainer-migration prereq. LESSON: reimplementing socktainer's parser to predict it is fragile — Phase 2c should investigate disabling socktainer's relay feature outright. See [[background-session-keychain]].

**Other durable facts:**
- **Subnet collision is real**: unprivileged `container system start` defaults its vmnet to **192.168.64.0/24 = the live tart fleet's bridge**. MUST set `~/.config/container/config.toml [network] subnet` (used 192.168.72.1/24) BEFORE first start. [[vmnet-nat-internetsharing]]
- **Egress**: fleet unreachable on both vmnet 64.x AND tailscale 100.x (host doesn't forward container→peer); host gateway/LAN + IPv6 closed. BUT a **default-NAT container reaches the host's OWN tailnet services** (rapid-mlx :8000, mlx-audio :8765) + internet. A **custom `container network create` net is NOT NAT'd → zero egress**. Mitigation: sandboxes on a custom net; hermes on pf/tailscale-only egress.
- **Memory**: ~340 MB RSS per IDLE micro-VM (measured via the `com.apple.Virtualization.VirtualMachine.xpc` backing proc; host-wide wired is useless — rapid-mlx wires ~20GB). A 2G machine holds ~356MB idle (no pre-wiring). Load/growth + no-page-release NOT cleanly measured (deferred).
- **Backup**: bind-mount host paths keep restic file-level; named volumes are opaque ext4 `volume.img` → migration MUST bind-mount state.
- **tailscale in-container**: userspace-networking works (no caps); real TUN needs CAP_NET_ADMIN (`/dev/net/tun` present but iface-create EPERM without it).
- **E2 wholesale NixOS-machine**: Apple machine rootfs is READ-ONLY + no guest initrd → NixOS configureDns fails (resolv.conf symlink into ro store). See [[e2-apple-machine-readonly-root]].
- **Repo side-bug found**: current flake.lock ships gvisor-20251110.0 which FAILS to build (Go 1.25/1.26 clash) → next hermes redeploy breaks. Task **827913e**.

**Standing watch** (task ad1beb): monthly-ish `gh` check of apple/container #158/#286/#66 + socktainer releases vs baseline (container 1.1.0 / socktainer v1.1.1, #158/#286 OPEN, #66 CLOSED). #158 or #286 closing = strong GO signal. CronCreate is session-only (7-day cap) so the backlog task is the durable carrier.
